name: Dorothy von Schneeter
original_name: ドロシー・フォン・シュネイテール
source:
She travels the world trying to remove the miasma curse left by the Demon King that has caused all women to develop abnormally large breasts and clitorises.

She is particularly embarrassed by the fact that her clitoris is much larger than every other woman's, but has a secret attachment to it because of the pleasure it gives her.
